name: Member's Mark Fresh Farm-Raised Atlantic Salmon Filets
whyItWorks: High-fat marine protein rich in natural anti-inflammatory omega-3 fatty acids. Skinless salmon cooked simply in olive oil produces zero abrasive roughage, soothing mucosal irritation.
